# AI video, image, voice and music API — Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Veo 3.1

**A prompt or photo becomes a video, image, voiceover, song or lip-synced clip through one varg API key.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_d85558840d5b.webp" alt="A quick reel of varg generations: a cat pilot grinning in a vintage plane above golden clouds, an elephant carrying a glowing observatory under the aurora, a white sneaker in an orange dust burst and a claymation supplement jar." width="480"></p>

Generate AI videos, images, voiceovers and music with one varg API key. Text- and image-to-video on Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Veo 3.1 and Wan 3; images and edits on Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.6 and Flux 3; lip sync and talking avatars; ElevenLabs v4 voices; Lyria and Mureka music; captions and multi-scene renders to MP4. Use when someone asks to make or render a video, animate a photo, generate an image, create a UGC ad, product video, slideshow or talking head, add voiceover (text to speech), music, lip sync or captions, or mentions varg. Cloud mode needs only curl; local mode runs on bun + ffmpeg.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-ai                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-ai --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | MP4 clips, images, speech and music files |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$2–5 per typical short video |
| Uses | varg API, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Veo 3.1, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.6, ElevenLabs v4, Lyria 3.5 |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v2.2.3) |

## Ask your agent

- "Animate ./cabin.jpg into a 5-second 9:16 clip with slow snow falling"
- "Generate a 30-second voiceover for this script and a calm instrumental bed to go under it"
- "Make a 3-clip product video of my ceramic mug at 720p first, then render the keeper in 1080p"
